text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—To everyone who loves the Twinkle 
Series!! The moment has finally arrived!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Today's main race! The festival of 
Umamusume! It's the Japan Derby!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Looks like this year will be the 
best race yet. Just being in this 
atmosphere gets my heart racing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —We've finally made it this far.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And at the same time... I'm getting 
pumped up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My body is aching to show what the 
"current" me can do on the turf as soon as 
possible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
……The one who's truly dependable is you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you so much for everything up until 
today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
To you, who believed in me, supported me, 
guided me, and strove to surpass our 
limits together—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I hope I will be able to present you with 
the title of Derby Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I shall be on my way.
choice_data_list: Go out there and leave nothing behind!

Go out there and give it everything you've 
got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu's younger sister... looks 
like she's in good shape. She's staying 
calm despite the grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No, no, the favorites have gotta be those 
two!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...All the more reason to defeat them...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Just for today... absolutely... I won't 
lose to anyone...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...With this body, at this very moment, I 
shall become a brilliant radiance, slender 
yet unyielding—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan, heading out...!
